source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Graph whole-folder stub sends no request and returns success with UseLegacyFallback::Yes. The native receiver then enumerates unread headers and calls per-message MarkMessagesRead. Successful stub completion therefore requests further work; it does not mean remote folder items have already been marked.
title: Graph whole-folder mark-read asks the native caller to mark unread messages individually
